value.note: positive anchor: proves the rewrite completed and ps_main's own parameter is still declared with type VS_OUTPUT (i.e. the run did not fail before reaching the point where this matters).

absence: VS_OUTPUT's own struct declaration must be present somewhere in the output for ps_main's signature to remain self-consistent HLSL. Its disappearance while still named by the retained parameter is exactly the defect quoted in the issue body -- the entry point's OWN, otherwise-unread parameter type is dropped from the 'used types' set.

note: Ask 1 (the issue's title): dxr -remove-unused-functions -remove-unused-globals -E ps_main removes struct VS_OUTPUT even though it types ps_main's own (unread) parameter. all_of guards against the not_regex clause being satisfied for free by a failed/empty rewrite (see control-entry-not-found.hlsl).
